goal: Explain one fictional wearable product through a photorealistic exploded view with inspectable component hierarchy.
audience: Industrial-design reviewers assessing product architecture and material plausibility

content.subject: One original mixed-reality work visor shown as a vertically stacked exploded product diagram

art_direction.style: Photorealistic technical industrial product visualization with an exploded internal structure
art_direction.lighting: Large diffused studio light with soft cool fill and restrained rim separation

composition.layout: Vertical exploded product diagram with axial alignment, even layer spacing, and symmetric off-axis battery modules
composition.viewpoint: Centered nearly orthographic 85 mm industrial product view

objective_checks: The complete product and all nine layers are visible
No readable text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Components form one plausible device rather than disconnected props
Optics and batteries are paired and symmetric
Materials read as real engineering materials rather than a cartoon or toy
The centered exploded hierarchy remains legible at normal viewing size
